fields.summary_ko.0: CrowdStrike Holdings (NASDAQ:CRWD) stock declined 8.9% following the Zscaler acquisition announcement, in contrast to the Nasdaq index rising 6.2%.
fields.summary_ko.1: CrowdStrike announced an all-stock acquisition of Zscaler for $43.9 billion, with Zscaler shareholders expected to hold approximately 16% of the combined company.
